title: Bank Authorization Agreement
intro: This Bank Authorization Agreement (“Agreement”) is entered into between Y7 Consulting Inc. d/b/a Y7 Logistics (“Y7”) and the undersigned dealer (“Dealer”) for the purpose of authorizing Y7 to bill Dealer for weekly carrier payment deposits.

sections.title: 1. Authorization Scope
sections.body: Dealer authorizes Y7 to issue weekly invoices for carrier payment deposits, calculated based on Dealer’s pending orders, 4-week carrier cost average, and a 10% safety buffer. Dealer agrees to remit payment via ACH or wire transfer to Y7’s designated bank account by the due date specified on each invoice.

sections.title: 2. Weekly Invoice Schedule
sections.body: Invoices will be generated every Friday covering the preceding week (Monday through Sunday). Due date will be the Monday following invoice issuance, providing sufficient time for ACH processing. Invoices will be delivered via email to the address on file.

sections.title: 3. Service Fee
sections.body: Dealer agrees to Y7’s service fee of $60 per shipment for the prepay billing model, covering carrier coordination, payment processing, and account management. This fee is in addition to carrier costs and is included on the weekly invoice.

sections.title: 4. Balance Management
sections.body: Y7 will maintain a running balance of Dealer’s deposits and carrier payments. Dealer may view current balance and transaction history via the Y7 portal at any time. If Dealer’s balance becomes negative, Y7 reserves the right to pause new order acceptance until balance is restored.

sections.title: 5. Termination
sections.body: Either party may terminate this Agreement with 7 days written notice. Upon termination, Dealer’s outstanding balance will be settled through final invoice or refund as applicable.

sections.title: 6. Dispute Resolution
sections.body: Any billing disputes must be raised within 14 days of invoice date. Y7 will investigate and respond within 5 business days. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts.

checkboxes.bank_auth_billing: I authorize Y7 Logistics to issue weekly invoices for carrier payment deposits as described above.
checkboxes.bank_auth_payment: I agree to remit payment via ACH or wire transfer by the due date specified on each invoice.
checkboxes.bank_auth_service_fee: I understand and accept the $60 per shipment service fee for the prepay billing model.
checkboxes.bank_auth_terms: I have read, understood, and agree to all terms stated in this Bank Authorization Agreement.
